keywords: EIP-8250 一次性 nonce 标记
summary: Frame 交易和交易断言的规范集中定型：EIP-8141 定义验证前缀与执行体，EIP-7906 规定断言失败会回滚执行体，EIP-8250 提议把 keyed nonce 改成一次性的“已用”标记。隐私方向，ERC-8441 提出混合后量子隐形地址方案，钱包无需协议改动即可接入。Gnosis Chain 成为第一个采用 FCR 的 L2，存款快了 20 到 30 倍。

items.topic: 隐私：后量子隐形地址与私密稳定币
items.title: Magicians：ERC-8441 混合后量子隐形地址方案
items.note: 11:18（namncc，PR）。它在 ERC-5564 中定义 schemeId 3：支付密钥由 ML-KEM-768 封装与 secp256k1 ECDH 组合而成，只要 ML-KEM-768 安全，未来有量子计算机的对手也无法从公告日志看出谁收了款。每个隐形地址仍是普通 secp256k1 EOA，不需要协议改动和新合约。
items.title_en: Magicians: ERC-8441 hybrid post-quantum stealth address scheme
items.note_en: 11:18 (namncc, PR). It defines schemeId 3 under ERC-5564: the payment secret combines an ML-KEM-768 encapsulation with a secp256k1 ECDH secret, so as long as ML-KEM-768 holds, an adversary with a future quantum computer still cannot tell from the announcement log who was paid. Each stealth address is still an ordinary secp256k1 EOA, with no protocol change and no new contract.
items.topic_en: Privacy: post-quantum stealth addresses and a private stablecoin

image.credit: Ethereum Magicians, ERC-8441: Hybrid post-quantum stealth address scheme
image.credit_en: Ethereum Magicians, ERC-8441: Hybrid post-quantum stealth address scheme

summary_en: Frame transaction and transaction assertion specs firmed up: EIP-8141 defines a validation prefix and an execution body, EIP-7906 says a failed assertion reverts the execution body, and EIP-8250 proposes turning keyed nonces into single-use spent flags. On privacy, ERC-8441 proposes a hybrid post-quantum stealth address scheme that wallets can adopt with no protocol change. Gnosis Chain became the first L2 to adopt FCR, with deposits 20 to 30 times faster.
